description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

List the catalogs available on the server, optionally for a specific catalog type. If using the `latest` parameter, return only the latest catalog available for each individual catalog type available. Pagination parameters are ignored when using the `latest` parameter. Additionally, archived and unready catalogs are not returned when using the `latest` parameter.

query.description: Whether to retrieve only the latest catalog for each applicable catalog_type.
